gate_3.name: Architecture Claims Gate
gate_3.summary_sentence: All Model C (LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B) architectural claims verified: 24-layer sequential tri-hybrid topology (13 conv, 5 sliding_attention, 6 full_attention), 4-group grammar (142 valid linear targets), and 13 conv.conv + 11 self_attn.gate_proj exclusions confirmed.

claims.statement: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B is a 24-layer sequential tri-hybrid model interleaving 13 gated short-convolution (conv) layers, 5 sliding-window local attention layers (window=256), and 6 full-context global attention layers (partial_rotary_factor=0.5).

All 13 depthwise short-convolution kernels (conv.conv, shape [2048, 1, 7], groups=2048) and 11 per-head scalar sigmoid attention gates (self_attn.gate_proj, shape [16, 2048]) are marked Validity.EXCLUDED with explicit architectural justification.
